spans.s: guḍa, cf. a-lavaṇa-guḍa-kṣobha (IE 8-5); sugar, the production of which was the monopoly of the king or landlord.
guḍḍa, guḍḍa-dhvaja (IA 10), Kannaḍa; the meaning of guḍḍa is doubtful; probably, a disciple.
guḍānta-patra (Journal of the Bihar Research Society, Vol. XL, Part 2, pp. 96-97), name of a type of document, the exact nature of which is doubtful; probably, a kind of lease deed. Cf. guṇa-patra.
Guḍika (EI 28, 31), maker or seller of sugar; see Gauḍika.
